Hello, Mr. Hishida, please take care of me! I'm a fan of your illustrations of Tinari, and I really like the casual and lonely atmosphere of your work!

When I saw that you were opening up requests, I immediately submitted a request. I'd like to have an illustration of my own ooc, and the link to the reference drive will be attached below. The content of the illustration would like to be like the ending scene of Ophelia in Hamlet, lying in a river full of flowers, something like that composition and atmosphere.

Purpose: Post to display on your own social media platforms. Possibly (no definite plans at the moment) to be used as a background for future video submissions.

Need to change the price teacher can also propose! Hopefully my request will be accepted, thanks again very much-

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1VbITgMZ2-OtBh3josiPzaBW8HsQ9IVYF?usp=drive_link

💗: A wandering wizard, a bard who plays old and mysterious musical scores... He is always smiling, as if he never knows how to get angry. She has pitch black eyes and a red totem ornament on her cheek. She is always smiling, as if she doesn't know how to get angry.

💙: A girl who watches over the sheep in the meadow, she is a descendant of the druids. She is a kind and polite girl and is loved by all the animals. The point to keep in mind is that she doesn't often smile broadly!

I'd like to see a scene with a warm atmosphere... a scene like wind + sunshine + meadow + forest + daisies... Or even a scene where they are baking cookies in a wooden hut would be wonderful! I love an atmosphere full of the tenderness of nature, so please feel free to draw it 🥰.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1HK_AraAYQ68Ge3_n0LikI8o1WhZWs81V/view?usp=sharing

Good evening, nice to meet you.

I fell in love with your illustration at first sight!
If you don't mind, could you please draw my OC?

[Situation desired].
I would like an illustration of Ophelia of Millet.
If it is an unreasonable order, or if it does not fit your style, you are free to modify and change it.

About the character
This is an OC from the Ark Knights worldview.
He is a world-traveling researcher and a resident of the deep sea.
He is also free, inquisitive, kind-hearted and beautiful.
*It does not matter if he wears a visor or not.

Please check the X post tree down for more details about the character.

Thank you in advance for your interest.

菱田さん！！！ Hello！！！
I came across your tighnari artworks and found the attention to detail and cozy atmosphere so incredibly charming, I'd be very honored if I could commission you for a 16:9 illustration of my character to use as a wallpaper.
This is my vtuber character: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1t6q9kPjFnjGmW-6hUD9k0rjLS0xjl3ex?usp=sharing
She's a sleepy hamster girl with the tendency to fall asleep anywhere at any time. Although shy and introverted, with the instinct to hide in walnuts and the like, she feels most comfortable in nature.
She is inspired by the cotton plant, and is actually about the size of one cotton ball (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10eJWCAps2RIg9xHSgi0zFPUEvfr0co15?usp=sharing).

Feel free to do what you like!!! 
If the amount is too little, please feel free to resend me an appeal with the desired amount, thank you so much, truly!!!!!!!!!

Nice to meet you, I love your work! I would like to ask you to draw my character if you would be willing to do so!
Below are the specific requirements for your request.
Her name is Nico and she has a lovely personality. She always has a little rabbit with her, which symbolizes beautiful love. The theme of the illustration is "kind young lady". As for the outfit, you may either design it for the teacher or use this outfit. It would be nice if the scene could be like having afternoon tea in a flowery garden. Of course, if the teacher has a better idea, you can use it as much as you like, focusing on the natural scenery. It would be great if you could draw the background as well.
Thank you very much and I would be very happy if you could send it to me as PSD data!
Scope of use Personal use and use in free works

Hello 菱田さん,

I really love 菱田さん's beautiful art with nature landscapes.  If possible I would also like to request a drawing of my OC as well.

I would like a forest or other natural background that seems a little magical or mysterious. If it is not too much trouble, could you please draw her in blue and white witch robes (something similar to the style of Witch Hat Atelier)?  I leave it up to you, please feel free to amend the idea however you think its best!

Thank you for your consideration.

Please draw my character! He is a cat boy that works at a hotspring for monsters and spirits. Please include lots of nature, wood objects and plants in the image.
The image should be at least 1920x1080 as I would like to use it as a wallpaper.

性格は内気で、少し憂鬱なショタです！
▼服装などはこちらを参考にしてください▼（以前の絵なんですけど）
